items.title: Red Holloway interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: and all them, we used to work all, and what’s his name, Collins

ctx.x: morning about 5 AM Tuesday morning. I mean and I mean every club had something happening. You know so what would happen, I used to see Joe, he might be working at DeLisa and then he would probably go over to maybe over on 39th Street or to the Dusable Hotel or some of those different places and maybe do a gig or something. And you’d always, everybody would meet up at a certain place and have breakfast, and during those days the popular food was brains and eggs. Of course I know you wouldn’t think of that today.…
and all them, we used to work all, and what’s his name, Collins, he’s dead now, guitar player.
